```renyi
module savings.schedule

import std.console as console
import std.environment as environment

public type AppError is Text

public function main() or fails with AppError
  needs console, environment
  purpose: Print a yearly savings schedule with compound interest.
  example: main() is nothing

  let arguments be environment.arguments()
  if arguments.length is less than 4 then
    console.print_error("usage: savings.schedule START_AMOUNT YEARLY_RATE_PERCENT YEARS")
    fail with AppError("missing command-line arguments")
  end

  let start_amount_text be arguments.at(1)
  let rate_text be arguments.at(2)
  let years_text be arguments.at(3)

  let start_amount be start_amount_text.to_decimal() otherwise
    console.print_error("invalid start amount: {start_amount_text}")
    fail with AppError("invalid start amount")
  end

  let yearly_rate_percent be rate_text.to_decimal() otherwise
    console.print_error("invalid yearly rate: {rate_text}")
    fail with AppError("invalid yearly rate")
  end

  let years be years_text.to_integer() otherwise
    console.print_error("invalid years: {years_text}")
    fail with AppError("invalid years")
  end

  let yearly_rate be yearly_rate_percent / 100.0

  console.print("Year 0: {start_amount.rounded(2)}")

  let mutable balance be start_amount
  let mutable year be 1

  repeat until year is greater than years
    set balance to (balance * (1.0 + yearly_rate)).rounded(2)
    console.print("Year {year}: {balance}")
    set year to year + 1
  end

  return nothing
end
```

```renyi
module savings.schedule

import std.console as console
import std.environment as environment

public function main() or fails with InputError
  needs console, environment
  purpose: Print a yearly savings schedule with compound interest.
```
```renyi
  example: main() is not used directly in tests

  let arguments be environment.arguments()
  if arguments.length is less than 4 then
    console.print_error("usage: savings.schedule START_AMOUNT YEARLY_RATE_PERCENT YEARS")
    fail with InputError(message: "missing command-line arguments")
  end

  let start_amount_text be arguments.at(1)
  let rate_text be arguments.at(2)
  let years_text be arguments.at(3)

  let start_amount be parse_money(start_amount_text) otherwise fail with InputError(message: "invalid starting amount")
  let yearly_rate_percent be rate_text.to_decimal() otherwise fail with InputError(message: "invalid yearly rate")
  let years be years_text.to_integer() otherwise fail with InputError(message: "invalid number of years")

  console.print("Year 0: {format_money(start_amount)}")

  let mutable balance be start_amount
  let mutable year be 1

  repeat until year is greater than years
    let interest be round_to_cent(balance * yearly_rate_percent / 100.0)
    set balance to round_to_cent(balance + interest)
    console.print("Year {year}: {format_money(balance)}")
    set year to year + 1
  end
end

function parse_money(text: Text) returns Decimal
  purpose: Parse a money amount from text.
  example: parse_money("100.00") is 100.00

  return round_to_cent(text.to_decimal())
end

function format_money(amount: Decimal) returns Text
  purpose: Format a decimal amount as cents with two digits after the decimal point.
  example: format_money(12.3) is "12.30"

  return amount.rounded(2).to_text()
end

function round_to_cent(amount: Decimal) returns Decimal
  purpose: Round a decimal amount to the nearest cent.
  example: round_to_cent(10.005) is 10.01

  return (amount * 100.0).rounded().to_decimal() / 100.0
end

public type InputError
  purpose: An invalid command-line input.
  has message: Text
end
```
